# Layer evaluation (generated by `python -m verify.evaluate`; numbers from eval.json)

Labels: static 108 human labels (MINOR counted as SAME, 47 DIFFERENT); GIF 34
ground-truth pairs (MINOR counted as SAME, 4 DIFFERENT). AUC with 2000-resample
percentile bootstrap 95% CI. LOO threshold = verdict cut refit on the other
labels, applied to the left-out one.

## Static, layer `pixel.max_tile` (pre-registered primary)

| Check | AUC | 95% CI | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| All 108 (score is not fitted, so LOO AUC = this) | 0.593 | 0.478–0.701 | |
| Held-out new32 (9 DIFFERENT) | 0.546 | 0.269–0.797 | |
| Threshold LOO over 108 | acc 0.639 | bal. acc 0.619 | |
| Threshold fit on orig76, tested on new32 | acc 0.688 | bal. acc 0.580 | |

Secondary `pixel.global_dissimilarity`: AUC 0.496 (0.379–0.610) on all 108;
0.657 (0.454–0.840) on new32. Not a candidate primary; no evidence it is better.

## GIF, layer `temporal.dtw` (primary)

| Check | AUC | 95% CI | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| All 34 (4 DIFFERENT) | 0.558 | 0.161–0.906 | Reproduces the earlier 0.56 |
| Threshold LOO | acc 0.794 | bal. acc 0.558 | |
| In-sample cut 0.097 | acc 0.824 | bal. acc 0.683 | 2 of 4 positives caught, 4 false positives |

Reproduction: recomputed DTW matches `src/gif/all_dtw.json` to max abs diff 5.8e-5.

Errors at the in-sample cut: the four false positives are the
`selection_synchronization` pairs (SAME). Their frames differ only in scroll
offset, so the DTW cost does not absorb them. Missed positives:
`ios/empty_view_rtl_dark` (score 0.005) and `ios/switch_light` (score 0.0001).
Both are invisible to the temporal layer, so the verdict is wrong for them.

## Reported only (not reproduced: features are not in this repo)

- Static Siamese head, LOO 108: 0.695 (0.62–0.78) with ResNet-18 + the E2 fine-tune
  (`data/results/train_log.txt`); 0.664 (0.59–0.74) with `train2_rn.txt`.
- Grok v2 logistic on hand features, LOO 108: 0.909 (0.85–0.96)
  (`data/labels/.../v3_results.txt`). The LPIPS, DINO and OCR feature extraction
  that produces it is not in the repo.

## Conclusions

- The only static layer wired in is pixel SSIM. It is near chance (0.59, CI
  includes 0.5). It is not a usable static verdict.
- The GIF temporal layer's AUC is in line with the earlier 0.56, but the CI
  (0.16–0.91) is too wide to use with 4 positives.
- To reach the Grok v2 level, the layers that carry signal (LPIPS, DINO, OCR,
  element geometry) need to be ported into `src/verify/layers/`. Their feature
  code is not in this repo.
- The layout layer is a stub; it cannot be scored until the harness exports a tree.
